description: Small histories the generator made and signed, with the Ed25519 keys of section 6 and keys of seeds of its own (Ed25519, Ed448, ES256 after RFC 6979): their documents as JSON text, to be read as POI reads JSON, and replays taking them step by step. A replay "accepted" takes every step; one "refused" takes every step but its last, which it refuses (naming "reason", where both implementations word it alike), and takes "control" in place of the last one, the document refused but for what the replay is about. Anchored snapshots: a snapshot of the head or of a checkpoint another server gives, a history started from it only anchored in the trust anchor at the time "at" (10.5, Anchored); a refusal takes its "control", the snapshot, the trust anchor and the time with what it changes given otherwise.

histories.description: The roaming network rn1 of DE*RNO, the quorum of Alpha and Beta with signing keys for the party, for certificates and for tariffs alone; the parties it adds, among them a conformity assessment body and a grid operator without keys, and what they add.
